plugins.name: task-web
plugins.description: Personal web tools and research demos with fixed zyx corners, a focused workspace and ui.zyx.tw.

plugins.name: pve

plugins.name: nycu
plugins.description: NYCU portal, E3 coursework, public timetable and part-time attendance through MCP.

plugins.name: macos
plugins.description: Native organization, complex recurrence, availability planning, ID-based Mail drafts and permission diagnostics, plus Safari and screenshots through MCP.

plugins.name: ubereats

plugins.name: zyx
plugins.description: Skills for slides, docs, academic writing, Next.js and the dev workflow.

plugins.name: tailscale
plugins.description: Read-only Tailscale MCP tools for devices, the live policy file and policy validation.

plugins.name: stick
plugins.description: One MCP tool for every machine you can ssh into: commands on Linux or Windows, tmux and a Windows desktop.

plugins.name: secret-mod
plugins.description: Ask for credentials in a form, keep them in the macOS keychain, and run commands with them without showing the values to Claude.

plugins.name: hum
plugins.description: A band above the prompt with every machine's CPU, memory and disk, read from sensorium.

plugins.name: music-mod
plugins.description: /music: what macOS Music.app is playing, in one line above the prompt.

plugins.name: today-mod
plugins.description: /today: the day's agenda from Calendar, E3 deadlines and Reminders, above the prompt and in Claude's context.

plugins.name: golem-mod
plugins.description: golem alerts in Claude Code: a line above the prompt while an incident is open, a toast when one opens or resolves, and /golem for the list.

plugins.name: ship-mod
plugins.description: Pull requests and deploys in Claude Code: a line above the prompt while CI runs or a deploy is under way, a toast when one ends, and /ship for the list.

plugins.name: i-have-dyslexia
plugins.description: Shape Claude Code output for a dyslexic reader: short sentences, one idea per line, a fixed reply skeleton, bold anchors.

plugins.name: admiralty-code
plugins.description: Grade each claim an agent reports with the Admiralty Code: source reliability A to F, information credibility 1 to 6.

plugins.name: paper-generator
plugins.description: Idea-to-paper pipeline: discuss an idea, pick a venue, run experiments, write the LaTeX paper and iterate with simulated peer review.
